release_notes: Safe Page white pages, plus a critical fix for local offers. The cloaking Safe Page selector now groups landings by their group (optgroup with a 'No group' bucket at the bottom), so a library of dozens of whites stays navigable, and a magnifier button opens the search picker for one-click selection. A new 'Local Offer' safe mode lets a LeadForge direct local offer act as the white page: bots get its uploaded files inline on the campaign URL (index.php) or via the new public /offers/<id>/ address (click.php, Click API); a missing or non-local offer falls back to the default page. Fixed: a stream whose only destination was a direct local offer died with 'URL not found.' — the uploaded page is now served as intended, and the Click API answers with its /offers/<id>/ address instead of an empty URL. Also fixed: databases upgraded 1.0.2 → 1.0.4 never received the allow_php_landings seed rows (LeadForge builds failed with php_landings_disabled) — migration 30 inserts them, and a missing row now means enabled; explicit '0' keeps the feature off.
